Montreal is an international classification framework used for the age-based stratification of patients with [[ibd|IBD]] [^src1]. It is mentioned once in the provided corpus within the 2023 annual report from the Danish IBD quality database (DANIBD), which notes that the age of all patients is calculated according to the Montreal classification [^src1]. The broader report covers epidemiological data and quality indicators for adult IBD patients in Denmark between October 1, 2022, and September 30, 2023 [^src1]. No further details regarding the specific age brackets or the history of the classification system are available in the current evidence.
